title: TransactionSafe
tagline: Insurance platform offering the possibility to both protect the DeFi ecosystem and increase the yield of yield bearing assets.
description: This project combines yield farming and interoperability with a granular risk assessment to protect efficiently the DeFi users! This project allow the user to get a coverage on multiple platforms for a cheaper price and for the required period of exposure. This projects aims at incetivizing the users to deposit their tokens to insure others transactions thanks to a custom yield farming mechanism.
how_its_made: This project uses Chainlink to support multiple assets to back funds of insurance smart contract . It uses nextjs for the front end and is Deployed on the Sepolia Blockchain. It has been developed using Remix and relies on the Push protocol to alert the users of a high risk and thus reduce the global exposure.
